TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: Transaction to execute the creation of the massive pricing rules
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. Input and validations: The transaction obtains pricingRuleRequest and invokes ABKOR001.executePostMassivePricingRules(pricingRuleRequest). The library validates that the request and its details exist, that there are at least two ACT details, that ACT detail ids are neither null nor duplicated, that every detail has entityType and id, and that effectiveDate.endDate is not before effectiveDate.startDate. 2. Decisions and branches: The library separates ACT details from the rest, builds one pricing rule per ACT detail, copies the common fields into each generated rule, applies default precedence and progressive values when they are absent, and stops with an advice if duplicate validation or detail value resolution fails. 3. Libraries and invoked methods: The transaction calls ABKOR001.executePostMassivePricingRules. Inside the library, validatePostPricingRule validates each generated rule, checks duplicate variable and regulated pricing rules, resolves each detail value from the repository, obtains audit and batch identifiers, creates the massive custom attribute, adds a CUS detail with value MASIVA to each generated rule, persists each pricing rule and its details, and returns the created list. 4. Errors and follow-up actions: Any PricingRuleException raised in the library is converted into an advice with its description. After the call, the transaction assigns pricingRulesResponse and, when the advice list is not empty, sets severity EWR. 5. Outputs and assignment conditions: On success the response contains the persisted pricing rules with generated ids, resolved detail values and the additional CUS detail. On handled business errors the library returns an empty list, and the transaction still assigns that empty list to pricingRulesResponse.
